title: Algorithmic Recourse Under Competition
abstract: arXiv:2609.39877v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Algorithmic recourse provides individuals who have received undesirable outcomes from machine learning models with suggestions for minimum-cost improvements to achieve the desired outcome. A central assumption when computing recourse is that the decision rule remains fixed throughout the recourse implementation phase. We challenge this assumption in settings where individuals compete for limited resources. In such settings, widespread recourse implementation can change the acceptance threshold even when the scoring model that is used to evaluate individuals remains the same. This change in acceptance threshold can, in turn, invalidate the original recourse recommendations (i.e., following the recourse may not lead to the desired outcome). translated_title: 竞争环境下的算法救济
translated_abstract: 算法救济为那些从机器学习模型中获得不理想结果的个体提供建议，帮助其以最小成本的改进来实现期望的结果。计算救济时的一个核心假设是：决策规则在整个救济实施阶段保持固定不变。我们在个体为有限资源相互竞争的场景中挑战了这一假设。在此类场景中，即使用于评估个体的评分模型保持不变，大规模的救济实施也可能改变接受阈值。而接受阈值的这种变化反过来可能使原有的救济建议失效（即，遵循救济建议未必能带来期望的结果）。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一个名为“竞争下的救济”的框架，该框架对接受建议的个体及其所需满足的推荐分数目标进行联合优化，以平衡……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“竞争下的救济”框架，指出当个体竞争有限资源时，大规模实施救济会在评分模型不变的情况下改变接受阈值、使原有救济建议失效，并通过联合优化救济建议与所需满足的分数目标来解决这一问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a "recourse under competition" framework, showing that widespread recourse implementation shifts acceptance thresholds when individuals compete for limited resources—invalidating original recommendations—and jointly optimizes recourse suggestions with the score targets individuals need to satisfy.
